definitions.explanation: Making an exact copy of a document, image, or other material. A formal term often used in official and technical contexts.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}を{複写|ふくしゃ}する。
この{資料|しりょう}は{複写|ふくしゃ}{禁止|きんし}です。
examples.english: Copying of this material is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}の{複写|ふくしゃ}サービスを{利用|りよう}して{論文|ろんぶん}のコピーを{取|と}った。
examples.english: I used the library's reproduction service to get a copy of the paper.

notes: More formal than コピー (copy). Common collocations: {複写|ふくしゃ}{禁止|きんし} (no copying allowed), {複写機|ふくしゃき} (copier, photocopier), {複写|ふくしゃ}サービス (reproduction service). Often seen on official documents, library signs, and copyright notices. In computing contexts, コピー is generally preferred over {複写|ふくしゃ}. Related term: {複製|ふくせい} (reproduction/replica), which emphasizes creating an identical copy of an object or work of art.
